divergences.case: Windows CF_DIB and CF_DIBV5 clipboard images
divergences.preSync: The native image path depended entirely on arboard and returned an error for certain Qt BI_BITFIELDS DIB layouts.
divergences.postSync: The pinned upstream DIB fallback synthesizes a BMP file header with an explicit pixel offset and returns the decoded PNG.
divergences.reason: Adopted as an upstream improvement: V4/V5 headers embed masks that arboard's header-less BMP decode misplaces.

divergences.preSync: Text copy dropped its transient arboard handle immediately, which can stop the X11 selection owner from serving requests.
divergences.postSync: The native implementation retains one arboard Clipboard instance for the process lifetime.
divergences.reason: Adopted as an upstream improvement (issue #2075) so copied selections survive after the copy call returns.
